messages.text:
Solaris, this is of the utmost extreme seriousness importantness. 

I need a photo of Jesus trying to hold the world in his hands, like the song "he's got the whole world in his hands", except he can't, because of the stigmata, it keeps falling through. 

Please, this will be hilarious!
Here’s your requested image! I hope it brings the humor you envisioned. Let me know if you need any adjustments or more creative concepts.
Try again, he can't hold onto it, he's sad because it keeps slipping through the holes!
Here’s the revised image with Jesus sadly struggling to hold onto the Earth as it slips through the stigmata. Let me know if this captures your vision or needs any tweaks!
One more time, with the earth falling, below his hands not above them
Here’s the updated image showing the Earth falling below Jesus’ hands, with a sad and reflective expression. Let me know if there’s anything else you’d like adjusted!
